CANONICAL_FORMULA.TR: TR_t = max(H_t - L_t, abs(H_t - C_{t-1}), abs(L_t - C_{t-1}))
CANONICAL_FORMULA.naming_note: written as EWM(alpha=1/14, adjust=False) and NOT as "RMA(1/14)" — Pine ta.rma() seed semantics are not asserted to be equivalent and were not proven so

HISTORICAL_NUMERIC_SEMANTICS.input: the enriched store OWN stored OHLC
HISTORICAL_NUMERIC_SEMANTICS.note: identical two-cause structure to rsi_14 (ff41fc4d06619667), and the same 131 tickers

CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.proposed: Massive full-precision 15m OHLC -> round to 2dp -> TR -> EWM(1/14)
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.test: round(lean base, 2) -> ATR, compared to stored atr_14 on AAPL
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.result: 33,508 mismatches out of 33,508 rows — every single row
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.cause: round(base,2) != enriched OHLC on 7.77% of cells. The differences are exactly half-cent ties (x.xx5) resolved in BOTH directions: base 139.585 -> pandas 139.58 but enriched 139.59; base 141.815 -> pandas 141.82 but enriched 141.81. Max |diff| is exactly 0.010000.
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.amplification: ATR is recursive, so a 7.77% input tie difference propagates and makes 100% of downstream ATR values differ
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.CONSEQUENCE: the Massive ATR port must be declared a NEW DETERMINISTIC DEFINITION, not a reproduction of the historical column. Stating "round to 2dp reproduces history" would be false.
CRITICAL_FINDING_PROPOSED_TRANSFORM_DOES.unresolved: the exact historical tie-rounding convention was not identified

MASSIVE_AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.emit_rule: ATR emitted only on COMPLETE bars
MASSIVE_AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.contaminated_gap: if chronological ATR state would cross an UNOBSERVED_CONTAMINATED interval, the state is INVALIDATED, restarted on the first subsequent COMPLETE bar, and marked initialization-sensitive until the registered warmup rule is met
MASSIVE_AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.rationale: continuing previous-close/TR state across an unobserved path would encode information about that unobserved path

NEGATIVE_FIXTURES.N: carry state across contaminated gap: DECLARED forbidden (not testable here — Massive availability layer)
NEGATIVE_FIXTURES.N: round before 15m aggregation: DECLARED forbidden (not testable here — no 1m surface in this gate)

DETERMINISM_SMOKE: two identical runs produce bitwise identical output — PASS

FAILURE_CLASS_CHECK.test: full-history vs head-truncated (last 2000 bars) on the same final 2000 bars
FAILURE_CLASS_CHECK.reading: ATR is genuinely initialization-sensitive. The production implementation MUST run full per-ticker history and must not repeat the incremental-slice failure class that damaged rsi_14, CISD, WLNBB and P/D.

not_a_pass: this is NOT a clean PASS: the historical tie-rounding convention is unidentified, so a Massive port cannot claim historical numeric equivalence
not_done: availability semantics declared but not implemented
